name: Kim B. Barrus
bio:
Kim founded Lifestyle Med Spa after experiencing medically supervised GLP-1 weight loss treatment himself — the practice exists because he decided others across Ventura and Los Angeles counties should be able to get the same thing done properly.

As Chief of Operations he oversees the practice and the patient experience, so that every visit feels personal, unhurried and welcoming. Medical care is provided by the clinical team, led by Michael Rankin, MD and Kristina Dino, NP.
